display.purpose: Card/page titles, e.g. the login card's "StaffTrack" title.

body.purpose: Default UI text, form labels, descriptions, table cells.

label.purpose: Table headers, field labels, status chips.

mono.purpose: IDs, phone numbers, timestamps, anything meant to align in a column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view (e.g. login's "Sign in").
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.36rem); background: var(--primary, #1E90FF); color: var(--primary-foreground, #FFFFFF); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #1E90FF) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #1E90FF) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis actions, e.g. the app shell's "Log out".
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E5E4); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.36rem); background: var(--background, #F8FAFA); color: var(--foreground, #16191B); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, #16191B) 5%, var(--background, #F8FAFA)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #1E90FF) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface, ring instead of shadow, used for the login form container.
components.html:
StaffTrack
Sign in with your phone number and password.
Form content
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; background: var(--card, #FFFFFF); border-radius: var(--radius-xl, 0.63rem); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, #16191B) 10%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--card-foreground, #16191B); } .ds-card-description { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5B6368); } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 1rem; }

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: The Field + FieldLabel + Input pattern every form control uses.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, #16191B); } .ds-input { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E5E4); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.36rem); background: var(--background, #F8FAFA); color: var(--foreground, #16191B); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #1E90FF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #1E90FF) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #5B6368); }

components.name: Destructive Alert
components.description: Form-level error banner, e.g. the login page's "Invalid phone or password".
components.html: Invalid phone or password.
components.css: .ds-alert-destructive { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, #dc4a3f) 30%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.36rem); background: var(--card, #FFFFFF); color: var(--destructive, #dc4a3f); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-alert-destructive svg { margin-top: 0.125rem; } .ds-alert-description { font-size: 0.875rem; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, #dc4a3f) 90%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
StaffTrack is the room behind the counter, not the storefront: an owner or manager's working surface for scheduling, task oversight, attendance, and coverage across branches of a market chain. The system is quiet and dense rather than expressive — closer to a well-run ledger or a register terminal than a marketing product. Its job is to make status legible at a glance across many rows (shifts, tasks, staff, branches) and to get a manager in and out of a task fast, not to hold attention.

One deliberate exception carries the brand: a single confident blue accent, used sparingly for primary actions and interactive state. Everything else is neutral. Staff-facing screens (viewed on a phone, on shift) get the same restraint but larger touch targets and less information density per screen than manager/owner screens.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained: neutral slate ground, one committed accent, no decorative color
Dense and scannable for manager/owner screens; simplified and touch-first for staff screens
Flat by default — structure comes from borders and spacing, not shadows
A workhorse UI typeface, not a display face; nothing here performs personality through type

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Market Blue appears only on the primary action per view and on interactive/focus state. Never as a background fill for large regions, never as a second competing accent elsewhere on the same screen, and never doing double duty as a status color.

rules.name: The No-Display-Face Rule
rules.body: Nothing on an Operate screen is set in a font chosen for personality. If a heading wants more presence, that's a weight/size change, never a new typeface.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A card or table row sitting in its normal place never has a shadow. A shadow means "this is floating above the page right now" (a menu, a modal), not "this is a card."

dos: Do spend Market Blue on exactly one primary action per view.
Do default to borders and spacing for structure, not shadows.
Do keep staff-facing (phone) screens to one primary action and larger touch targets than manager/owner screens.
Do use Geist Mono for anything meant to align in a column (times, IDs, phone numbers).
Do wrap every form control in Field + FieldLabel, never a raw div/label.
donts: Don't introduce a second decorative accent color alongside Market Blue.
Don't use a display/serif/expressive typeface anywhere in this system — this is an Operate surface, not a marketing one.
Don't add shadows to resting cards, table rows, or sidebar items.
Don't reduce information density on manager/owner screens to chase a "cleaner" look at the cost of scanability.
Don't attach a credential/login error to one field when it isn't attributable to it — use a form-level Alert instead.
